ctx.x: Louis, who would you say was the greatest influence on your life? Not in your youth, not musicians, I mean individuals. In your family or?

Well, my mother, she taught us the real things. She always said, you probably never get rich. She was wrong there, wasn't she? Well, she might be. Maybe, you know, maybe $10 million to save $10, you know. But I mean, what she means were have yachts and still got a zillion. We wasn't even thinking about that. She wasn't even thinking about it when she told me, say, but you'll always have health. So take a laxative every night of your life. And that's the finest things you ever told me. You didn't have much money…
When did you leave New Orleans?
